title: dichapetalum bojeri
intro: Dichapetalum bojeri, commonly known as the 'Hedge or Poison Tree', is a plant species native to tropical Africa, known for its medicinal properties. The plant is used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which can help in treating wounds, fever, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Dichapetalum bojeri include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
